card.name: Overdose management and safe storage wording
card.fires_on: Words in overdose sections where management or removal instructions begin, such as Treatment after overdosage, or partway through gastric lavage and charcoal-sorbitol. Also the word safely in storage warnings.

modes.label: Treatment of overdose
modes.description: The word Treatment right after an overdosage statement.
modes.example: In the event of overdosage,<< treatment>> should address the symptoms and supportive measures,

modes.label: Safe storage
modes.description: The word safely in a warning to keep medicines away from children.
modes.example: Store buprenorphine-containing medications<< safely>> out of the sight and reach of children

modes.label: Lavage and charcoal terms
modes.description: Partway through words like gastric or sorbitol in decontamination instructions.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese words, and the suppressed ones are recovery words, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on wording about what to do after an overdose or accidental exposure, such as treatment, lavage and safe storage.
